# cdesktop UI reference

Pilot's `static/shell.css` adapts cdesktop's neutral color tokens and compact coding workspace styling. The implementation keeps Pilot's own HTML structure, JavaScript behavior, API contract, and data model; no cdesktop runtime dependency is required.

- Upstream: https://github.com/cdesktop-ai/cdesktop
- Source revision: `75bd015e88f9797d785c9fabcfca03c7151fd5cc`
- Referenced source: `packages/web-core/src/app/styles/new/index.css` (saved here as `theme-source.css`)
- License: Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE`); upstream attribution (`NOTICE`)

Copies of `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` are also in `src/main/resources/static/third-party/cdesktop/` so they ship with Pilot's server jar.
